decision.summary: Two regions warrant closer inspection: (1) early window (365–544) with abrupt N jump and complex cross-axis oscillations, possibly superposed temporary offset and motion; (2) late window (605–729) showing a sharp, multi-sample jump into a stable high-amplitude platform across all axes, consistent with a permanent displacement event.

regions.observation: Cross-axis shape shows a multi-sample abrupt upward shift in N (from ~0.5 to ~2.1) around index 370–372, followed by oscillatory behavior with large E excursions (e.g., +3.77 at index 468) and U swings; no clear return to prior baseline, suggesting possible superposed temporary offset and ongoing motion.

A sustained high-amplitude platform emerges from index ~610 onward: N jumps sharply to ~10–13, E drops to ~-4 to -7, U stabilizes near 3–5, with minor fluctuations but no reversal—suggesting a permanent jump or long-term deformation onset; the transition is abrupt over 2–3 samples (indices ~608–610), and the region includes the full post-jump plateau through last sample.
